annotations.title: Remove an AppLovin creative set from its campaigns

description: Take an AppLovin creative set out of its campaigns (all of them, or campaignIds). AppLovin’s API has no delete or archive, so this is its only removal: the set and its assets stay on the account and can be added back. Call it WITHOUT confirm FIRST: nothing changes and you get the campaigns it is in; show the user, then call with confirm:true, plus confirmName (its exact name) and confirmChildren when the reply asks for them. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

campaignIds.description: only these campaigns (up to 20); omit for all

confirm.description: true to remove, after a first call without it has shown the campaigns

confirmChildren.description: the campaign count the unconfirmed call reported

creativeSetId.description: AppLovin creative set to take out of its campaigns
